title: Cartoon Boing
blurb: The classic springy boing: a character rebounding off something they had no business rebounding off. It descends directly from the golden age of Warner Bros. and MGM shorts, where sound editors built a whole language of exaggerated physics out of stretched springs, slide whistles and whatever else was lying around the foley room. Nothing signals "do not take this seriously" faster. Perfect for pratfalls, double-takes and anything that needs to bounce. Physics has left the building, taking its laws with it.
origin: A classic cartoon spring effect in the Warner Bros. foley tradition.
